questions.stem: On the transit board, the 08:10 train departs more punctually than the 08:25 bus; which wording is correct?

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.topic: The comparative of equality with tan and como
questions.learningObjective: Form a tan... como equality comparison
questions.stem: Explain why a transit planner writes 'tan rápido como' instead of 'más rápido que' when two trains cover the same route in equal time.

answer.exemplar: The planner uses tan... como because the two trains take the same time, expressing equality rather than superiority or inferiority, and más... que would wrongly claim one is faster.

questions.explanation: Tan... como states equality of degree, while más... que states superiority. Choosing the wrong frame would misreport the two trains as unequal in speed.
